name: outreach-send
doc: Teder's /leads hands a pitch to Toran, which sends it from our WhatsApp number as the approved Marketing template (Toran src/ops/outreach.ts, docs/whatsapp-templates.md "Pitches to leads"; Teder src/leads/outreach.js). It is between Teder and Toran alone, so it is not one of openfrequency-accounts' contracts: this file is kept byte for byte the same in both repositories' test/fixtures, and each side's test reads it. sent false is never an error: why says what held it, said is the operator's sentence for it, and Teder marks the lead sent only on sent true.

routes.auth: Authorization: Bearer <OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN>, from this machine only, never through Caddy

answers.case: held: stopped (the number asked to be removed), already (this stage went to this number), cap (the day's pitches went), quiet (night, Shabbat, a holiday), quality (Meta's rating of the number or the template is not green), no_line (our number is not on Meta), bad_page, bad_phone, or failed (Meta refused it)

body.said: הגענו היום למכסת ההודעות ללידים, אז לא נשלח כלום. מחר אפשר שוב.

answers.case: OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN is not set on Toran
not from this machine, or through Caddy
no token, or a wrong one

a body that is not a pitch: product teder or toran, stage first or reminder, phone 8 to 15 international digits, name 1 to 200 characters, url an http(s) page whose path is /s/<slug>, ref [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,100}
